snippet.title: Drums Rock - Power Metal Music Pack
snippet.description:
A new DLC has arrived in Drums Rock and is now available. Get this DLC with a large number of new songs!

The new Power Metal DLC with the collaboration of Nuclear Blast is now available!

Add-Ons DLC:
"Hearts of Fire" - Hammerfall
"King for a Day" - Battle Beast
"Blood of the Elves" - Blind Guardian
"When Angels Kill" - Fifth Angel
"Twilight Force" - Twilight Force
"Higher" - Northtale

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38541
PSVR2: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10006907

Twitter: https://twitter.com/PlayDrumsRock
